correctness.rationale: Classical fixed-order Hankel asymptotics give a common exact moment pole B_d/(q-q_c); the adjacent phase profiles have equal periodic means and uniformly bounded primitives, so their difference converges at q_c and continuously from above. Positivity follows from Xu Theorem 3.9 positive Bessel cells at q_c>2. A mean-value integral gives the sharp 1/d absolute and linear relative rates, with the normalization (2pi)^d accounted for. Optional finite numerics confirm only low-dimensional cell signs.
